```{r}
data=read.csv("C:/Users/vreid/Downloads/clean.csv")
```

```{r}
# Create the categorical variable
data$Lead_Category <- with(data,  ifelse(
  (Private.Service.Line.Material != "NOT LEAD" | Public.Service.Line.Material != "NOT LEAD"), 
  ifelse(
    (Private.Service.Line.Material %in% c("LEAD", "GALVANIZED REQUIRING REPLACEMENT") & 
     Public.Service.Line.Material %in% c("LEAD", "GALVANIZED REQUIRING REPLACEMENT")), "Both Lead",
    
    ifelse(Private.Service.Line.Material %in% c("LEAD", "GALVANIZED REQUIRING REPLACEMENT"), "Private Lead Only",
           
    ifelse(Public.Service.Line.Material %in% c("LEAD", "GALVANIZED REQUIRING REPLACEMENT"), "Public Lead Only", 
           NA))),  # This will never trigger, but ensures all conditions are covered
  "Neither Lead"  # Only if both are "NOT LEAD"
))

# View summary
table(data$Lead_Category)

```

```{r}
data$Public_Service_Binary <- with(data, ifelse(
  Public.Service.Line.Material %in% c("LEAD", "GALVANIZED REQUIRING REPLACEMENT"), 
  1,  # Public service line is lead
  ifelse(Public.Service.Line.Material == "NOT LEAD", 
         0,  # Public service line is not lead but is some other material
         NA  # Neither (if it's "NOT LEAD")
  )
))

data$Private_Service_Binary <- with(data, ifelse(
  Private.Service.Line.Material %in% c("LEAD", "GALVANIZED REQUIRING REPLACEMENT"), 
  1,  # Public service line is lead
  ifelse(Public.Service.Line.Material == "NOT LEAD", 
         0,  # Public service line is not lead but is some other material
         NA  # Neither (if it's "NOT LEAD")
  )
))
```

```{r}
data$ward = as.character(data$ward)
data$property_zip <- sub("-.*", "", data$property_zip)
data$property_zip[data$property_zip == 0] <- NA
data$property_zip = as.character(data$property_zip)
data$Age = as.numeric(data$Age)
data$tract_pop = as.numeric(data$tract_pop)
data$tract_white_perc = as.numeric(data$tract_white_perc)
data$Rooms = as.numeric(data$Rooms)
data$Bedrooms = as.numeric(data$Bedrooms)
data$Near.Major.Road = as.character(data$Near.Major.Road)
data$Wall.Material = as.character(data$Wall.Material)
data$Roof.Material = as.character(data$Roof.Material)
data$Garage.indicator = as.character(data$Garage.indicator)
data$Porch = as.character(data$Porch)
data$Garage.indicator = as.character(data$Garage.indicator)
data$Construction.Quality = as.character(data$Construction.Quality)
data$Use = as.character(data$Use)
data$Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land. = as.numeric(data$Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land.)
data$Land.Square.Feet = as.numeric(data$Land.Square.Feet)

```


```{r}

model = glm(data$Public_Service_Binary ~ data$`Bedrooms` + data$`tract_white_perc` + 
                 data$tract_pop + data$Wall.Material + data$Roof.Material + 
                  data$Age + data$`Near.Major.Road` + 
                 data$Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land. + 
                  data$Land.Square.Feet +  data$tract_midincome+data$ward, family="binomial")
```


```{r}
summary(model)
Predicted_Prob <- predict(model, type = "response")
Predicted_Class <- ifelse(Predicted_Prob >= 0.5, 1, 0)
Predicted_Class

table(data$Private_Service_Binary-Predicted_Class)
```

```{r}

model = glm(data$Private_Service_Binary ~ data$`Bedrooms` + data$`tract_white_perc` + 
                 data$tract_pop + data$Wall.Material + data$Roof.Material + 
                  data$Age + data$`Near.Major.Road` + 
                 data$Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land. + 
                  data$Land.Square.Feet +  data$tract_midincome+data$ward, family="binomial")
summary(model)
```

```{r}
library(nnet)
model = multinom(data$Lead_Category ~ data$`Bedrooms` + data$`tract_white_perc` + 
                 data$tract_pop + data$Wall.Material + data$Roof.Material + 
                  data$Age + data$`Near.Major.Road` + 
                 data$Prior.Tax.Year.Market.Value.Estimate..Land. + 
                  data$Land.Square.Feet +  data$tract_midincome+data$ward)

```
```{r}
model
```

```{r}
fitted(model)
predict(model)
```

```{r}
table(predict(model))
```



